description: Asks the MCC desk to move the person's appointment to a different time. Nothing changes right away: the current time stays booked until the desk confirms a new one by email, usually within a few hours. Give up to 3 start values from available_times in start_times, or describe times in preferred_times. Confirm with the person first and pass confirm: true. Needs their private booking link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…; request_service returns it as status_url)

preferred_times.description: Or describe the times that work, e.g. weekday evenings after 6

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

start_times.description: Up to 3 start values from available_times

name: request_new_time
title: Ask to move an appointment
